verdicts.reason: Both share the same faults. The dark logo panel is cropped so the sun icon is cut off and the SOLSTICE wordmark is tiny. 'Ships late June' breaks into a cramped three-line sliver. The legal text is about as large as the body copy and is jammed against the right edge, and the CTA is a small pill squeezed into the top-right corner next to it. B is slightly better because its button is fully formed with even padding, while A's button looks clipped and tight at the top edge.
